findings.title: Frozen corpus contains nested works across the LOBO boundary
findings.evidence: Бирюк, Певцы and Хорь и Калиныч have word-5gram containment 95.72%, 97.77%, and 97.24% in Записки охотника; one chunk is byte-identical (SHA-256 12549537…). All four works are tested separately in frozen LOBO and RuAA manifests.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: The fold mask removes only groups == held-out work_id. Therefore each standalone fold trains on almost the same text inside the collection; the collection fold trains on the standalone stories. Independent word- and char-shingle scans reproduced the containment.
findings.actual_consequence: The independence assumption is false and corpus-derived accuracy/headline values can be inflated. The historical 0.8805 value is not a clean external-accuracy estimate until a corrected corpus protocol is rerun.
findings.affected_scope: Frozen audit corpus, legacy full benchmark, planned exploratory and confirmatory LOBO/RuAA; not the five-fold repair smoke.
findings.minimal_fix: Block new accuracy/headline claims and mark the affected manifests ineligible for new runs.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Create a registered corpus/fold migration with a cross-work exact+asymmetric-containment graph; adjudicate collection versus constituents or treat their component as one exclusion unit. Preserve old artifacts as historical evidence.
findings.regression_test: Reject exact cross-work chunks and short-in-long containment; assert every train/test fold has disjoint content components; allow repetitions only within one registered work.
findings.change_risk: High scientific and compatibility risk; requires owner/editorial decision and reruns.

findings.title: Untrusted pickle/joblib/NumPy object deserialization can execute code
findings.evidence: Configured cache and deployment paths are loaded with pickle.load/joblib.load/allow_pickle=True before any external digest or regular-file trust check. Catching exceptions occurs after pickle opcodes have executed.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Place a crafted pickle at the predictable configured reps/model path; invoking cache load or legacy predict executes its reducer before schema validation. The review did not execute a payload.
findings.actual_consequence: Arbitrary code execution under the runner account; a valid-looking substituted cache can also silently change features and scientific results.
findings.affected_scope: Production representation cache, legacy model deployment, ignored certificate and legacy benchmark utilities.
findings.minimal_fix: Document and enforce trusted-local-only inputs; reject symlinks and verify a pre-registered digest before loader invocation.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Use a non-executable, schema-validated representation format and one content-addressed model bundle with externally trusted digest/signature policy.
findings.regression_test: Monkeypatch deserializers to prove trust validation precedes load; reject symlink/substitution/hash mismatch using inert fixtures.
findings.change_risk: High migration risk for existing caches/models; cache rebuild required.

findings.title: Cleaning can retain stale corpus bytes and silently substitute the modeled source
findings.evidence: Per-file failures return 0, the command never stages or clears input_clean, and success count is only logged. Deleted raw inputs and failed replacements leave old cleaned files in place.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Clean a work, remove or change its raw file, then rerun; the prior input_clean work survives. Inject normalize failure and the command still returns success with old bytes.
findings.actual_consequence: The modeled corpus can differ silently from the current raw source while appearing successfully rebuilt, enabling corpus substitution and false reproducibility/headlines.
findings.affected_scope: Raw-to-clean corpus build used by run.sh and subsequent split/train/evaluation.
findings.minimal_fix: Make any expected-file failure fatal and verify exact input/output bijection before success.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Build an immutable, content-addressed cleaned snapshot in staging with raw-source manifest/digests and atomically switch one pointer only after complete validation.
findings.regression_test: Deletion removes stale output; injected failure leaves the prior complete snapshot current; exact source/output inventory and digests match.
findings.change_risk: High corpus migration/operational risk; do not clean in place.

findings.title: Case framework binds roles by path, not content, permitting target-to-train leakage
findings.evidence: Containment checks compare resolved paths only. Inputs use errors='ignore'; passports store mutable paths/user provenance without computed byte inventory. Current 53 case specs had no exact target/candidate duplicate, but the API is fail-open.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Copy target bytes to a differently named candidate file with a legal path. Path validation passes, target features enter closed-set training, and the framework can issue strong/high.
findings.actual_consequence: A circular historical attribution can be presented as strong; mutations and UTF-8 data loss are not detectable from the passport.
findings.affected_scope: Case-study framework and existing/future passports; no claim that current passports contain this exact duplication.
findings.minimal_fix: Strict UTF-8; SHA-256 every input; reject target/candidate exact and registered normalized duplicates; bind an inventory digest.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Introduce a versioned CaseInputManifest/CorpusIdentity with immutable role, byte, normalized-content, and source-provenance bindings.
findings.regression_test: Different-path copy, symlink/hardlink, normalized containment, invalid UTF-8 and post-run mutation all fail closed.
findings.change_risk: High passport schema and historical-compatibility risk.

findings.title: Blind benchmark schema does not enforce train/test content and identity isolation
findings.evidence: Blind rows may retain source.sha256, text_path, work, edition/period/topic/register. Validation forbids labels/spans only and never rejects duplicate source bytes/path/revision or a work crossing train to held-out/blind.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Give an opaque blind doc_id the train row's source.sha256, text_path and work while omitting labels. Manifest and artifact validation pass and the same bytes can be read on both sides.
findings.actual_consequence: Direct test leakage and identity disclosure can produce a false benchmark headline.
findings.affected_scope: SPOOF-RU/IDIOSHIFT-RU public benchmark boundary; unrelated to repair smoke/LOBO.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject duplicate content/path/revision and work/group crossing incompatible split roles; forbid identity-bearing blind metadata.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Separate public-redacted and custodian full-provenance manifests, bind them by a versioned mapping/digests, and enforce split-isolation centrally.
findings.regression_test: Exact-byte, same-work, same-path and same-revision train↔blind pairs fail; legal development-only multi-edition grouping passes.
findings.change_risk: Medium-high public schema compatibility risk; requires versioned migration.

findings.title: Blind scorer does not bind truth bytes to a pre-scoring escrow commitment
findings.evidence: Truth carries only manifest_sha256. Loader/scorer never require an independently published SHA-256/signature of exact truth bytes, despite protocol escrow language.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: After submissions are fixed, change labels, spans or evidence in truth.json while retaining identity/blind IDs/manifest_sha256; scorer accepts it and emits different metrics.
findings.actual_consequence: Custodian error or malicious substitution can change a blind external-test headline after submissions.
findings.affected_scope: Blind benchmark escrow/scoring; independent of train/blind split isolation and dual manifest source findings.
findings.minimal_fix: Require expected independently published truth SHA-256 before parse/scoring and reject missing commitment in scientific blind mode.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Versioned signed escrow record binding redacted/full manifest, truth, protocol, commit and timestamp; audit output carries all bindings.
findings.regression_test: Any committed truth byte mutation fails; exact truth passes; only clearly named synthetic integration bypass may omit escrow.
findings.change_risk: Medium scoring/escrow schema compatibility; version rather than mutate frozen identifiers.

findings.title: Fail-closed repaired stack makes the frozen confirmatory matrix infeasible
findings.evidence: Four train-only singleton classes make class-complete inner group CV impossible: when a singleton work is validation, its class is absent from inner training. Stack cells remain mandatory in A0-A4/Holm.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: The class-coverage preflight theorem applies to every outer stack fold; the repair smoke demonstrates StackClassCoverageError rather than a sentinel score.
findings.actual_consequence: The safe stack correctly fails, but the registered confirmatory family cannot finish.
findings.affected_scope: Legacy stylo_stack cells in frozen paired-audit matrix; equal channels cannot be silently substituted.
findings.minimal_fix: Run a manifest-level feasibility preflight and block scheduling before model fitting.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Owner-approved versioned protocol/matrix amendment or explicit withdrawal of infeasible stack cells, preserving old registration.
findings.regression_test: Frozen manifest preflight proves infeasibility and no checkpoint is created; feasible synthetic matrix passes.

findings.title: Prediction and rank tie semantics disagree across evaluation/control paths
findings.evidence: Core paths use stable smallest-index argmax and worst-tie rank sum(p>=p_true); paired control uses any tied argmax and best rank 1+sum(p>p_true).
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Uniform [0.5,0.5] with true/pred class 1 passes paired as correct rank 1, but stable argmax is class 0 and conservative rank is 2. Majority one-hot nonmajority rank is 47 in core and 2 in paired.
findings.actual_consequence: Checkpoints/auditor can accept false correctness, or repair evaluator/checkpoint validation can deterministically disagree.
findings.affected_scope: Generic LOBO, group-fold, paired checkpoints/result audit, majority baseline.
findings.minimal_fix: Choose one explicit versioned tie/rank contract and use it in all validators/assemblers.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Create shared PredictionContract with class order, stable top1, rank definition and compatibility reader for historical artifacts.
findings.regression_test: All-zero, tied-top, majority and three-class ties yield identical results through every path.
findings.change_risk: High artifact/schema migration risk despite small code diff.

findings.title: Confirmatory evaluator allowlist authenticates a label, not canonical code
findings.evidence: Any callable named work_balanced_ablation_factory passes. Source/config/passport hashes are self-declared; test deliberately blesses _fake_factory. No canonical production callable with that name was found.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Supply a different callable with the allowed name and internally consistent evidence; runner executes it and shape/hash checks do not establish estimator identity.
findings.actual_consequence: Once the execution pin is opened, noncanonical mathematics could enter a confirmatory result.
findings.affected_scope: Paired-audit evaluator registration/control plane; current hard pin prevents execution today.
findings.minimal_fix: Pin module, qualname, canonical source/config/mechanism digest and reject substitutions.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Use an immutable evaluator registry whose evidence is independently derived from the instantiated estimator.
findings.regression_test: A same-name fake callable is rejected before a fold/checkpoint.
findings.change_risk: Medium registry migration; latent criticality after execution approval.

findings.evidence: Modified tracked lobo imports untracked equal-channel source; syntax_features imports untracked experimental replacements after tracked misspelled modules are deleted. An ignored 535-line .py lives inside the discovered production package and changes wheels/code hashes.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Build/archive only tracked HEAD: current imports/features/evidence differ or disappear; a nominally git-clean tree can still package ignored certificates.py.
findings.actual_consequence: Merge/archive/wheel cannot reproduce the reviewed current behavior.
findings.affected_scope: Current user rework only; committed HEAD remains a separate closed snapshot but lacks the repair/equal implementation.
findings.minimal_fix: Track/review intended executable sources or move historical/local code outside discovered package; do not rely on ignored .py.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Enforce an executable-source manifest and CI rule that all imports/discovered package files are tracked and archive-reconstructible.
findings.regression_test: git archive/wheel imports every public route and exactly matches the source manifest; ignored/untracked dependency fails.
findings.change_risk: Low functional but high evidence/history compatibility risk.

findings.evidence: CI runs only 61 release-integrity tests out of 872 and installs floating dependencies. Current full suite has one failure (raw json.dumps in smoke runner); clean clone tests depend on ignored PAPER/gen-paper files.

findings.affected_scope: CI, ordinary tests, docs/claim guards, clean archive.

findings.evidence: run_plan hashes requirements.lock and uv.lock when present, although uv.lock is ignored/noncanonical. Measured digest changes from requirements-only 289987… to 9359aa… with the ignored file.

findings.affected_scope: Paired-audit run plan/checkpoint identity.

findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Commit a reviewed lock/constraints family or bind an installed-distribution fingerprint under a versioned identity schema.

findings.title: Frozen golden migration depends on git HEAD history
findings.evidence: Current deletes b4_goldens files and adds renamed identical bytes; tests recover deleted fixture with git show HEAD:. After committing deletion or in an archive, fallback fails. Capture docs still name deleted runner/path.

findings.actual_consequence: Clean release cannot validate the frozen reference; compatibility identifier drift is hidden by local history.
findings.affected_scope: Frozen work-balanced golden fixtures/references/tests.

findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Version registered golden identifiers and migrate readers without changing frozen math/evidence.
findings.regression_test: Post-commit git archive tests with no .git validate both compatibility IDs.

findings.title: Repair smoke runner is not reconstructible from repair snapshot
findings.evidence: Artifact driver SHA matches current untracked runner (5e06df…), and source hashes match repair 07a8…, but the verified repair bundle contains no runner and HEAD lacks it.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: An independent party can authenticate a local runner but cannot recover its bytes from repair commit/bundle alone.
findings.actual_consequence: The diagnostic evidence is not independently rerunnable from the claimed committed snapshot.
findings.affected_scope: Five-fold repair smoke only; its claim exclusions are correct and it is not full accuracy.
findings.minimal_fix: Preserve the exact runner bytes as tracked evidence source or an immutable evidence bundle.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Create an evidence-source manifest tying runner, source snapshot, corpus subset and output hashes.
findings.regression_test: Clean bundle/archive recovers exact runner SHA and focused identity/output-isolation tests pass.

findings.title: Two incompatible trainers publish mixed, non-atomic artifacts to the same names
findings.evidence: Canonical trainer sequentially writes model.pkl/delta.pkl/authors.json; root legacy trainer overwrites model.pkl and different siblings. Both default to data. Interrupted canonical writes also mix generations.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Run canonical training, then legacy scripts/train defaults or inject failure after one write; predictor reads incompatible new+stale siblings without a generation manifest.
findings.actual_consequence: Crash, wrong scoring if dimensions align, or expensive rerun loss.
findings.affected_scope: Legacy deployment training/prediction.
findings.minimal_fix: Force distinct responsibility-named roots and reject incomplete/mixed sibling sets.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Use one versioned content-addressed bundle with manifest/digests and atomic current pointer; deprecate legacy writer after reference proof.
findings.regression_test: Cross-producer rejection, failure injection preserves old generation, concurrent publishers never mix.

findings.title: Legacy corpus loader silently drops scientific rows and can retain zero-row authors
findings.evidence: Recursive/fallback layout and broad read exception silently skip unreadable/empty files. Authors are enumerated first, so an unreadable-only author remains in class universe with no rows; disk provenance reload repeats the same omission.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Make one author's only chunks unreadable/empty. Loader continues, provenance agrees on truncated rows, and legacy train can publish a model that makes that listed author impossible.
findings.actual_consequence: Corpus rows/classes and work weights change silently; result can be self-consistently but incorrectly attested.
findings.affected_scope: Legacy load/train/deploy path; strict paired loader is stronger.
findings.minimal_fix: Malformed, missing, unreadable and empty expected chunks must be fatal; every discovered author needs rows/work.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Use the versioned CorpusIdentity inventory as the only loader contract.
findings.regression_test: Unreadable/non-UTF8/empty/renamed/missing chunk and zero-row author all fail before fitting.

findings.title: Sentinel class scoring remains outside repaired stack
findings.evidence: Absent classes receive -1e9 and are converted to finite -30 before softmax/metrics. Current inspected full/PD outer folds happen to be class-complete, so no current row is proven wrong by this path.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Use an inventory whose training fold lacks a class; benchmark emits a plausible normalized vector instead of failing.
findings.actual_consequence: Future/alternate benchmark silently fabricates probability mass and metrics.
findings.affected_scope: Obsolete/legacy benchmark fusion; repaired stylo_stack itself is fail-closed.
findings.minimal_fix: Shared class-coverage preflight and remove sentinel completion.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: One ProbabilityContract/ClassUniverse validator across all evaluation paths; version historical reader only.
findings.regression_test: Missing class, NaN/inf, wrong width/order must raise before softmax/publication.

findings.title: NLP/representation cache identity does not bind actual runtime pipeline
findings.evidence: Fallback NLP is cached under requested primary name; keys omit actual resolved model/fallback/max_length. DocBin/Rep payload text/model metadata are not verified. Smoke adds independent SHA/runtime receipts, but general runs do not.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Primary unavailable → fallback bytes cached under primary key; later primary or different fallback is available and stale fallback results are accepted as primary.
findings.actual_consequence: Same nominal configuration can use different/stale linguistic representations and scientific output.
findings.affected_scope: General LOBO/train/deployment caches; repair smoke specifically mitigates with pinned cache hash.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind resolved actual package/version/digest and validate doc.text/Rep payload against key.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Versioned safe cache schema with resolved runtime identity and content-addressed entries.
findings.regression_test: Fallback→primary, fallback A→B, swapped doc/text/Rep and corrupt payload reject/rebuild explicitly.
findings.change_risk: Cache rebuild and possible numerical drift.

findings.title: Fano module publishes invalid information and Bayes-error bounds
findings.evidence: Mean entropy of arbitrary model posteriors is called H(A|F); H(A)-that is called a valid MI lower bound; h^-1 is called unavoidable error. Data processing does not justify either without true conditional calibration.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Balanced binary labels with constant q=[.999,.001] have true I=0 and Bayes error .5, but code reports ~.9886 bits and floor .001. Balanced three-class constant q similarly reports positive MI.
findings.actual_consequence: False quantitative information/impossibility claims in tracked scientific artifact.
findings.affected_scope: Legacy Fano scientific module/docs, outside confirmatory matrix.
findings.minimal_fix: Withdraw valid-bound/Bayes-floor labels and mark values model-dependent descriptive.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Implement a separately validated proven bound with explicit assumptions, versioned schema and counterexamples; archive old JSON.
findings.regression_test: Constant overconfident output never yields positive MI lower bound or sub-.5 unavoidable binary error.

findings.title: validate-corpus reports fatal errors but CLI exits success
findings.evidence: Validator records severity=error for unreadable/empty/exact duplicates, but run returns report; CLI discards it and returns 0. run.sh explicitly relies on set -e to stop.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Two authors with identical books produce exact_dup error; stylo validate-corpus exits 0 and split/train/evaluate continue.
findings.actual_consequence: Known invalid/leaky corpus can pass the advertised fatal pipeline gate.
findings.affected_scope: Canonical all workflow and corpus report.
findings.minimal_fix: Nonzero/typed exception on any error; explicit --report-only for advisory use.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Central validation policy/gate object consumed by every corpus builder/orchestrator.
findings.regression_test: Subprocess exact duplicate/unreadable/empty cases exit nonzero and downstream stage marker is absent.
findings.change_risk: Low compatibility; advisory automation must opt in.

findings.title: split deletes complete corpus before replacement and silently publishes partial output
findings.evidence: train/unknown roots are rmtree'd before sentencizer/load/chunking; read/empty/no-sentence inputs continue and writes are sequential without staging/bijection.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Inject sentencizer exception after deletion: old corpus is lost. Inject one-book read error: command succeeds with a smaller corpus.
findings.actual_consequence: Data loss, partial corpus and silent estimand change before long evaluation.
findings.affected_scope: Raw cleaned-to-chunk corpus build.
findings.minimal_fix: Fail on any expected work and do not delete current output until full replacement validates.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Versioned staging root bound to clean manifest; atomically switch pointer and retain prior complete version.
findings.regression_test: Failures before/inside chunking, missing/extra works, crash and concurrent publisher leave old snapshot usable.

findings.title: Exploratory runners attest source once, allowing mixed-code long runs
findings.evidence: Code hashes are captured once before multi-cell/process execution; no rehash occurs before later cells, checkpoints or final publication despite comments claiming interrupted artifacts cannot mix states.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Change one hashed source after A0/first cell. Later workers/cells can import changed bytes, but final artifact retains pre-run attestation.
findings.actual_consequence: A multi-hour full exploratory result can be signed as code it did not exclusively execute.
findings.affected_scope: Both untracked true-LOBO and ablation-screen runners; no claim an existing run drifted.
findings.minimal_fix: Re-attest code/config/cache before/after each cell and immediately before final publication; abort on drift.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Reusable live RunAttestor passed into orchestration/workers with immutable source snapshot option.
findings.regression_test: Injected mid-run source change blocks new checkpoint/final publication and preserves prior complete state.
findings.change_risk: Low schema if hashes unchanged; high operational/numerical rerun cost.

findings.title: HTML report consumes stale legacy evidence and labels default GKF as LOBO
findings.evidence: Report hardcodes ignored docs/sweep_table.txt while current sweep writes v2 artifacts. Default run.sh sweep is GKF, but report says LOBO with bootstrap CI; missing evidence becomes '(нет данных)' with a fresh timestamp.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Run default sweep then report: v2 GKF is ignored; old legacy file or missing placeholder is rendered under a current LOBO claim.
findings.actual_consequence: Scientifically misleading/stale HTML that appears newly generated.
findings.affected_scope: Legacy report command/site input, not confirmatory publisher.
findings.minimal_fix: Read exact v2 artifact and derive wording from verified strategy/provenance; fail on missing/mismatch.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Artifact registry keyed by run_id/weighting/strategy with section-level hashes and typed claims.
findings.regression_test: GKF is never labeled LOBO; missing/stale/tampered provenance fails.

findings.title: Legacy prediction lacks authors/class/probability/distance contracts
findings.evidence: authors JSON is unchecked; classes_ are mapped into zero arrays without exact universe/order/type/range validation; probability/distance shapes, finiteness, nonnegativity and normalization are unchecked.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Model classes_=[0,2] with three authors silently zeros class 1; duplicate/negative indices overwrite/alias; NaN can reach argsort/winner.
findings.actual_consequence: Mixed/incomplete bundle can produce a wrong attribution rather than fail closed.
findings.affected_scope: Legacy deployment predict; mixed-generation producer makes it reachable.
findings.minimal_fix: Shared strict authors/classes/probability/distance validator before fusion.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Retire loose triple for schema/hash-bound bundle and public ProbabilityContract.
findings.regression_test: Incomplete/duplicate/bool/negative/out-of-range classes, duplicate authors, NaN/inf/wrong rows/unnormalized probabilities reject.

findings.title: Case strong verdict uses forbidden iid chunk pseudo-bootstrap
findings.evidence: Target chunks are flattened without work/document IDs; rows are resampled iid for margin_ci95; CI lower bound upgrades strong/high. Protocol explicitly forbids iid chunk bootstrap.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Duplicate/autocorrelate chunks of one disputed work; pseudo-sample size rises and interval narrows without new independent evidence.
findings.actual_consequence: Exploratory case attribution can be upgraded to strong confidence by dependent chunks.
findings.affected_scope: Case passports/verdicts; ten tracked passports say strong.
findings.minimal_fix: Set CI unavailable for one independent work and forbid CI-driven strong verdict; preserve work IDs.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Registered hierarchical/block/work uncertainty with estimand and minimum independent units.
findings.regression_test: Duplicated chunks cannot narrow CI/promote status; work boundaries survive load.

findings.title: Case required applicability/open-set gates are loaded but not enforced
findings.evidence: required_gates is echoed but not validated; gate_pass uses only panel feasibility. Closed-set nearest centroid always wins and strong/moderate needs no absolute fit/OOD/negative-control threshold.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Give an outsider uniformly poor but consistently nearest to one candidate; relative winner/margin can be strong.
findings.actual_consequence: Model applicability failure can be reported as historical attribution despite registered abstention policy.
findings.affected_scope: Case target decisions/passports.
findings.minimal_fix: Fail unknown required gates and prohibit strong/moderate absent registered target applicability gate.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Calibrated development-only open-set rejection bound into versioned passport and independent control evidence.
findings.regression_test: Outsider controls abstain; low absolute fit cannot become strong; required gate names are enforced.

findings.title: Benchmark score artifact is not bound to inputs or scoring configuration
findings.evidence: BenchmarkScore stores dataset identity and metric objects only. Manifest/truth/submission digests, tolerance, IoU threshold, bootstrap iterations/seed and verification status are discarded before CLI serialization.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Score different truth/submission bytes or change seed/threshold while preserving dataset identity; result JSON has no binding capable of distinguishing/replaying the run.
findings.actual_consequence: An archived blind score cannot prove what was scored or be independently bit-reproduced.
findings.affected_scope: Public benchmark scoring/result artifact.
findings.minimal_fix: Add exact input digests and all scoring parameters/seed to a versioned result envelope.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Self-hashed ScoreEnvelope binding protocol/code/environment, manifest/truth/submission, verifier receipt and deterministic replay.
findings.regression_test: Any input/parameter change changes binding; exact replay reproduces bytes.

findings.title: Literal abstention sentinel collision lets submissions inflate coverage
findings.evidence: Every non-None string counts as predicted; true None is converted to ordinary '__abstain__'. Labels accept any nonempty string, so submitting that literal yields the same comparisons but coverage 1.0 instead of zero. A truth class with that literal also makes a missing prediction compare as correct.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Replace every optional author prediction with '__abstain__': n_predicted=N and coverage=1. Or set a truth label to the same legal literal and a None prediction becomes correct after conversion.
findings.actual_consequence: Selective coverage endpoint can be directly gamed; arbitrary unknown labels also count as coverage.
findings.affected_scope: Public benchmark classification/selective-risk scoring.
findings.minimal_fix: Use typed internal abstention, reserve/reject sentinel strings and validate labels against allowed universe.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Versioned prediction schema with explicit abstain/confidence and preregistered selective-risk contract.
findings.regression_test: None, reserved string and unknown label cannot increase coverage; valid labels behave normally.
findings.change_risk: Small collision fix; medium-high selective endpoint schema migration.

findings.title: Public benchmark scorer does not require artifact/text verification
findings.evidence: CLI --root is optional. Without it, score_files skips artifact hash verification/document lengths and score_submission skips truth offset bounds.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Manifest can bind a 10-token file while truth and matching submission cover [0,1000); score without --root accepts IDs/hash, derives length from truth and returns perfect segmentation.
findings.actual_consequence: Official entrypoint can emit a false blind score for missing/tampered corpus or fictitious offsets.
findings.affected_scope: Public benchmark scientific scoring path.
findings.minimal_fix: Require artifact root or a digest-bound preverified ArtifactReport; always validate bytes/hash/length.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: ScoreEnvelope consumes one mandatory artifact-verification receipt; unbound scoring is private/test-only.
findings.regression_test: CLI without root fails; out-of-range truth fails; result binds artifact-report digest.

findings.title: Core import cycle and cross-layer private imports blur dependency direction
findings.evidence: AST graph has SCC stylo.workdoc ↔ stylo.corpus ↔ stylo.eval.provenance. Domain loading imports evaluation provenance at runtime; CLI/models reach private helpers across layers.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Static module graph/SCC and inbound-private census.
findings.actual_consequence: Changes to identity/I/O/evaluation propagate bidirectionally and are hard to test locally.
findings.affected_scope: Production package architecture.
findings.minimal_fix: Move neutral row/work identity contracts out of eval and stop new private cross-layer imports.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: domain.corpus_identity owns types; application/evaluation depend inward; artifact I/O depends on contracts, never vice versa.
findings.regression_test: Import-boundary test and acyclic graph assertion.

findings.title: Model registry and exploratory/confirmatory routing are scattered
findings.evidence: Factories/default sets/applicability/CLI help maintain overlapping model knowledge. final.py is exploratory comparison, while confirmatory control lives elsewhere.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: A new estimator must be edited/tested in multiple independent registries; equal isolation currently relies on several assertions.
findings.actual_consequence: Default/confirmatory leakage regression and inconsistent public discoverability are likely.
findings.affected_scope: Model routing/public CLI.
findings.minimal_fix: Document one authoritative registry and generate default/applicability views.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Typed ModelRegistry with explicit exploratory/default/confirmatory capabilities and immutable protocol IDs.
findings.regression_test: Registry coverage test ensures every estimator has one owner and equal stays opt-in/out of confirmatory.

findings.title: Several modules/functions combine too many independent responsibilities
findings.evidence: Cases mixes schema/path loading/features/gates/bootstrap/verdict/passport; CLI main is 328 lines/depth 17; true-LOBO duplicates checkpoint/identity/evaluation/reporting; provenance mixes identity, verification and publication.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: AST sizes/responsibility census; length alone was not used—each candidate has distinct state/I/O/statistics seams.
findings.actual_consequence: Local reasoning and focused testing are expensive; copy-paste checkpoint/validation variants diverge.
findings.affected_scope: Primary orchestration/god modules.
findings.minimal_fix: Extract only stable seams before full LOBO: validators/contracts/checkpoint store, leave numeric kernels intact.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Purpose-named modules with one-way APIs described in target tree; split cases and CLI after scientific blockers.
findings.regression_test: Characterization tests before split; import/API and byte-output parity after.
findings.change_risk: High numerical/refactor risk; most structural split should follow exploratory LOBO.

findings.title: Stack/equal fit does not finish fitting; predict refits all channels
findings.evidence: fit stores raw training arrays; predict_proba creates/fits vectorizers and SVCs. Equal also inherits private stack mechanics/fake arguments. Single LOBO prediction remains train-only and passport math is accurate.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Call predict twice or serialize after fit: learning repeats and raw corpus is retained; mutable factory/config changes can affect later prediction.
findings.actual_consequence: Estimator contract, privacy, repeat inference and performance are misleading.
findings.affected_scope: Legacy stack and exploratory equal estimator; not proof of current outer leakage.
findings.minimal_fix: Document evaluation-only lazy final fit and forbid deployment/serialization.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Train six channel pipelines/SVCs in fit; transform/score only in predict while preserving exact math.
findings.regression_test: Fit counters, repeated/batch/serialization parity and exact six-channel order.
findings.change_risk: High numerical parity risk; schedule after full exploratory LOBO unless deployment required.

findings.title: General macro-F1 label universe depends on predictions
findings.evidence: General metric uses unique(y_true ∪ y_pred). A predicted train-only singleton expands denominator while a model predicting none uses only 43 labels; strict paired path freezes labels.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Predict one singleton outside tested labels and compare to a model that does not; macro-F1 denominators differ.
findings.actual_consequence: Cross-model macro-F1 is not the same estimand.
findings.affected_scope: Generic evaluation summaries; strict true/paired paths mitigate.
findings.minimal_fix: Require explicit frozen metric label order.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Central MetricContract bound to run identity.
findings.regression_test: Singleton prediction cannot alter label denominator; unknown label rejects or follows registered policy.
findings.change_risk: Metric values change for affected historical runs.

findings.title: General metrics/significance accept malformed or broadcasting inputs
findings.evidence: No equal 1-D shape, finite/range, iteration/level/bin or exact-bool validation. y_true (n,1) and y_pred (n,) broadcasts to n×n; arbitrary values coerce to bool.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Pass mismatched shapes or NaN/invalid parameters; functions can return plausible values.
findings.actual_consequence: Silent wrong statistical summaries through public helpers.
findings.affected_scope: General metrics/significance; paired audit has stricter validators.
findings.minimal_fix: Central input validators and exact parameter types/ranges.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Typed MetricInputs/PairedOutcomes contract reused everywhere.
findings.regression_test: Adversarial shape, NaN/inf, bool/int, zero iters, invalid level/bin tests.
findings.change_risk: Low compatibility except callers relying on coercion.

findings.title: Stack internal model selection reuses calibration labels
findings.evidence: Each calibrator is selected/refit on all OOF labels, then meta CV/model choice evaluates globally calibrated Moof; validation row labels influenced their calibration mapping. W-off split is chunk-random rather than group-disjoint.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Static dependency trace label→global calibrator→meta-validation features for the same row.
findings.actual_consequence: Internal selection score/passport is optimistic, although outer held-out LOBO work stays untouched.
findings.affected_scope: Legacy learned stack internals.
findings.minimal_fix: Label the limitation and do not use internal score as unbiased evidence.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Nested/cross-fitted group-aware calibration or fixed registered fusion.
findings.regression_test: Calibration for a meta-validation row never fits/selects on its label/group.
findings.change_risk: High estimand/numerical change; may be superseded by protocol withdrawal.

findings.title: BurrowsDelta public branding contradicts frozen legacy denominator
findings.evidence: A0 relative frequency normalizes by selected-MFW mass, not all tokens; protocol acknowledges this while public name/docs call it true/classic Burrows Delta.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Inspect _rel_freq denominator against registered A3/A4 all-token implementation.
findings.actual_consequence: Readers can attribute results to a standard algorithm that was not implemented.
findings.affected_scope: Frozen A0/public display naming.
findings.minimal_fix: Document A0 as frozen legacy selected-mass Delta without changing math.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Compatibility display alias and versioned registry name; preserve frozen identifier mapping.
findings.regression_test: Known denominator example distinguishes legacy and canonical variants; docs/registry match.

findings.title: Ablation resume accepts self-hashed but semantically forged records
findings.evidence: Resume checks probability width/self-hash but not finite/range/sum or pred/rank/metric consistency; triage trusts stored metrics. Newly applied records are stricter.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Edit probabilities/metrics coherently enough to recompute self-hash; resumed triage consumes them.
findings.actual_consequence: Exploratory triage and model-selection evidence can be altered without detection.
findings.affected_scope: Untracked ablation screen/resume only.
findings.minimal_fix: Reuse full applied-record semantic validation and recompute metrics on load.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: One RecordContract for live and resumed paths bound to data/source identity.
findings.regression_test: Forged self-hashed NaN, wrong pred/rank and inconsistent metrics fail.

findings.title: Documented exact environment is neither canonical nor portable
findings.evidence: README/CI ignore requirements.lock; raw freeze has no hashes/platform/Python metadata and includes CUDA/heavy model packages, while pyproject ranges float. Local env drifted from lock in numpy/scipy/pandas/spacy/joblib.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Resolve/install on a fresh supported platform or compare current distribution versions to lock.
findings.actual_consequence: Researchers/CI can execute different numerical stacks; lock may be un-installable off origin platform.
findings.affected_scope: Packaging, CI and run identity.
findings.minimal_fix: Document one exact supported install path and fail on fingerprint mismatch for bound runs.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Platform-aware hashed constraints/lock family with CI resolution/install tests.
findings.regression_test: Fresh supported environment matches recorded distribution fingerprint.

findings.title: Research/documentation has contradictory normative status and stale code references
findings.evidence: Roadmap says control plane must be implemented while implementation audit says complete; protocol says both complete and no runner/builder committed; provenance alternates in-progress/sign-off. Line references point to unrelated current code. Actual Markdown target scan found zero broken link targets.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Follow each status/line reference against current inventory; mutually exclusive states coexist with no normative ledger.
findings.actual_consequence: Independent researcher cannot determine authoritative implementation/preparation/approval/execution state.
findings.affected_scope: README/research protocol/design/audit navigation.
findings.minimal_fix: Add one status ledger and label historical sections; replace unstable line refs with symbol+SHA.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Generate status/inventory assertions; frozen protocol edits require version/migration, not in-place rename.
findings.regression_test: Doc status contract matches tracked inventory/registrations; symbol links resolve at pinned SHA.
findings.change_risk: Low code, medium frozen-document governance risk.

findings.title: Pages generation/provenance can stay stale
findings.evidence: Deploy triggers only site/workflow changes although generator consumes docs; npm install is nondeterministic; generated manifest lacks source/output digests and provenance check verifies tracking only.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Change a consumed docs artifact without touching site: no deployment/freshness gate runs.
findings.actual_consequence: Public site can lag or differ from reviewed evidence.
findings.affected_scope: GitHub Pages and generated site data.
findings.minimal_fix: Trigger on consumed sources/locks, use npm ci and fail on generated diff.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Typed source registry with source/output digests and reproducible build provenance.
findings.regression_test: Fixture source change changes output; clean CI generation produces zero diff and bound hashes.

findings.title: Requirement-to-test map and critical runner coverage are not executable
findings.evidence: Fail-closed map is comments with one executable test; nodeids can disappear while map stays green. Smoke runner has zero test references; preparation runner has little contract coverage and no runner catalog.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Rename/delete a referenced test node: comment remains and suite does not validate the requirement map.
findings.actual_consequence: Governance coverage and evidence runners drift silently.
findings.affected_scope: Tests, exploratory/evidence scripts and docs.
findings.minimal_fix: Machine-readable required nodeids/markers and collect-only validation; document runner contracts.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Generate requirement→code→test registry and runner identity/output/claim tests.
findings.regression_test: Every required node collects; missing/renamed node and undocumented runner fail CI.

findings.title: Doc/Rep cache writers race and are not crash durable
findings.evidence: Fixed *.pkl.tmp and <key>.spacy.tmp names, no lock/merge-under-lock/fsync; global caches unsynchronized. Concurrent warms can truncate/replace each other's temp/canonical state.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Two processes synchronize before writing the same temp; one replaces/removes while the other writes. Inject crash before rename.
findings.actual_consequence: Regenerable cache corrupts or derails expensive long runs; stale plausible payload can be consumed.
findings.affected_scope: General representation and spaCy Doc caches.
findings.minimal_fix: Unique same-dir temp, fsync and explicit corrupt-cache handling.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Per-key/file lock with merge-under-lock and content-addressed cache entries.
findings.regression_test: Two-process barrier and injected crash preserve prior canonical readable cache.

findings.title: safe_write_batch promises a transaction but can leave mixed generations
findings.evidence: All temps are written, then independent os.replace calls execute in a loop without rollback/commit pointer. Failure after first replacement leaves new+old siblings despite all-or-nothing docstring.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Monkeypatch second os.replace to raise; first final file is already replaced.
findings.actual_consequence: Exploratory evidence/provenance siblings can describe different generations.
findings.affected_scope: Sweep/final exploratory multi-file publication.
findings.minimal_fix: Rename contract to per-file atomic and verify a batch manifest on consumption.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Versioned staging directory + self-hashed manifest + single atomic pointer/directory publication.
findings.regression_test: Second-replace failure leaves no resolvable new generation; crash/restart recovery test.

findings.title: Exploratory run identity/checkpoint/concurrency and full-run operations are weaker than paired control
findings.evidence: Run IDs bind checkout-local absolute config/cache paths; checkpoint save is exists-then-replace so concurrent timing-different writers can overwrite; ancestry/fsync durability is weaker. Generic LOBO uses n_jobs=-1 and has no per-fold resume; current Rep cache is ~690 MiB.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Relocate identical bytes: run_id changes. Barrier two same-run writers after exists(): last replace wins instead of conflict. Interrupt generic LOBO: completed folds are lost.
findings.actual_consequence: Relocation hurts reproducibility; concurrent/crash behavior and memory amplification make full exploratory operation harder to trust/diagnose.
findings.affected_scope: Untracked true-LOBO/checkpoint store and generic LOBO; paired store is stronger and telemetry in true-LOBO is positive.
findings.minimal_fix: Make absolute paths display-only, use create-without-overwrite conflict semantics, bound n_jobs and document memory/resume.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Extract one checkpoint/attestation service reused by exploratory/paired; content identities only, fsync directory/pointer, explicit resource budget.
findings.regression_test: Relocation equivalence, concurrent conflicting writers, crash durability, bounded worker/RSS and resume tests.
findings.change_risk: Run ID/checkpoint migration and operational cost.

findings.title: Legacy/duplicate topology and ambiguous names obscure ownership
findings.evidence: Package and root scripts compete for train/predict/evaluation; segment vs segmentation are distinct but ambiguous; final.py is exploratory; deleted experemental and untracked experimental form an incomplete rename. AST found exact script clones/private duplicate helpers.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Import/reachability/name census and artifact collision trace AUD-015.
findings.actual_consequence: Maintainers cannot infer canonical entrypoint or safely delete/archive old algorithms.
findings.affected_scope: Scripts/eval naming and dead/duplicate candidates.
findings.minimal_fix: Document canonical/legacy status and prevent legacy outputs colliding now.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: After reference proof: move to scripts/legacy with responsibility names; use eval/exploratory/model_comparison.py and rolling_attribution.py with compatibility shims.
findings.regression_test: No-reference proof, CLI/API compatibility and historical artifact replay before deletion/archive.

findings.title: Known-invalid certificate remains importable production code
findings.evidence: Ignored certificate tensorizes event affinity by chunk count and takes min per-channel floor as joint bound. Project docs record 546/903 claimed floors above achieved error and close it as invalid.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Run ignored log/certify_pairs.py; module can still emit CERTIFY_INDISTINGUISHABLE despite documented falsification.
findings.actual_consequence: A future caller can resurrect a known-invalid impossibility claim.
findings.affected_scope: Ignored current-only historical method, absent default/confirmatory paths.
findings.minimal_fix: Hard-disable inferential verdict with WITHDRAWN_INVALID_UNIT.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Move exact implementation/runner to historical reproduction or replace with descriptive divergence API; preserve hashes.
findings.regression_test: Known counterexamples never emit a lower-bound/certificate; package audit excludes withdrawn method.
findings.change_risk: Low functional, medium historical evidence handling.

findings.title: Heterogeneity API defaults to incomparable in-sample spaces and a fake significance label
findings.evidence: Default basis=None separately fits representation/SVD/scalers for target and each control despite doc saying this is impermissible. A four-control population-z >=2 is labeled significant without a null/sampling distribution.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Call compare_to_controls defaults: silhouettes from different optimized coordinate systems are compared and categorical verdict emitted.
findings.actual_consequence: Can manufacture an inferential two-hands/no-two-hands conclusion from incomparable descriptive scores.
findings.affected_scope: Dormant tracked API and ignored caller; valid docs/mixture_detection uses outsider basis separately.
findings.minimal_fix: Require one shared outsider-fitted basis and remove significance wording.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Registered work-level control/permutation design with shared representation and typed descriptive/inferential outputs.
findings.regression_test: Calls without shared basis fail; null/control order cannot create an inferential label.

findings.title: RuAA SHA inventory validation is not bijective/count-exact
findings.evidence: Duplicate path lines and extra/unlisted files are not rejected; n>0 suffices. Preparation records expected_files=141 beside verified count without enforcing exact registered set.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Duplicate one valid line and omit another while preserving line count/known mismatch; verification can pass.
findings.actual_consequence: A freeze candidate can overstate complete RuAA evidence inventory.
findings.affected_scope: Unapproved preparation candidate; becomes more severe if promoted unchanged.
findings.minimal_fix: Parse unique path→digest map and reject duplicates/omissions/extras; require exact registered set/count.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Signed/canonical inventory schema with root allowlist and exact set binding.
findings.regression_test: Duplicate, omitted, extra and 140-file success-path all reject.

findings.title: Invariance evaluator scores impossible/confounded splits
findings.evidence: Split builder marks impossible/confounded, but prediction alignment requires and evaluator scores all splits; worst_group includes them.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Two authors each exclusive to one source with y_pred=y gives possible coverage 0 yet worst/overall accuracy 1.0.
findings.actual_consequence: CLI/API can report perfect invariance where closed-set attribution is unidentifiable.
findings.affected_scope: Public invariance API/CLI; registered purged pilots mitigate and are not impugned.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject/omit predictions and estimates for impossible splits; exclude confounded cells from headline.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Typed feasible/unconfounded evaluation set bound to exact plan; diagnostic-only confounded slices.
findings.regression_test: Two-source counterexample emits no invariance point/worst-group; plan mismatch rejects.

findings.title: Site publication gate silently accepts malformed/nonfinite model metrics
findings.evidence: Generator rewrites raw NaN/Infinity tokens to null before JSON parse (including inside strings); unchecked Number() handles CSV; substring allowlist exempts entire models subtree from null/nonfinite gate.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: NaN, bogus or blank required model accuracy/F1/top2 becomes null/NaN, h.includes('models') bypasses gate, JSON.stringify publishes null with exit 0.
findings.actual_consequence: Comparative scientific metrics can disappear/change while site build succeeds.
findings.affected_scope: Public site generator.
findings.minimal_fix: Strict JSON, checked numeric parsing, exact nullable field paths only.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Typed source schemas with source/output hashes and atomic generated output.
findings.regression_test: NaN/Infinity/bogus/blank required metrics fail; legitimate exact null passes; prose token remains unchanged.

findings.title: Benchmark scorer hashes one manifest path but can score another object
findings.evidence: score_files accepts manifest object and manifest_path independently, hashes only path, but uses object for tasks/work/bootstrap semantics. CLI passes same source; exported public API permits divergence.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Pass validated manifest A and path B with matching identity/doc IDs but different work/task metadata; truth hash B passes while grouping/estimand comes from A.
findings.actual_consequence: Result can claim digest B while scoring semantics came from A.
findings.affected_scope: Public benchmark Python API; normal CLI wiring currently safe.
findings.minimal_fix: Load manifest internally from the one hashed path or exact-compare supplied object to strict load.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: One immutable ManifestBinding object produced by loader and consumed by scorer.
findings.regression_test: A/B same IDs but different work/task metadata fails before scoring.

findings.title: Manual benchmark validator makes an allowed unknown span unrepresentable
findings.evidence: JSON schema conditionally forbids evidence when ground_truth_known=false, but manual validator includes evidence in its unconditional required key set and then rejects it when false. Omitted and present evidence both fail.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Submit a schema-valid unknown span with start/end/label/ground_truth_known=false and no evidence: manual loader reports missing required evidence; adding it reports must be omitted.
findings.actual_consequence: Honest uncertain/unlabelled benchmark regions cannot be represented through the public runtime despite declared schema.
findings.affected_scope: Public mixed-span benchmark interoperability.
findings.minimal_fix: Require only start/end/label/ground_truth_known; allow evidence then enforce it conditionally.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Generate/manual validation from one schema contract to prevent drift.
findings.regression_test: False-without-evidence passes both schema/runtime; false+evidence fails; true evidence requirements remain.
findings.change_risk: Low migration risk: accepts previously impossible valid input.

findings.title: Invariance public API accepts an incomplete metric label universe
findings.evidence: Caller-supplied labels are averaged directly without requiring observed y_true subset, uniqueness or exact type. CLI derives labels and is currently safe.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: y_true=[A,B], y_pred=[A,A], labels=[A] reports macro-F1 2/3 instead of fixed-universe 1/3.
findings.actual_consequence: Public API callers can omit a difficult truth class and inflate invariance macro-F1/n_labels.
findings.affected_scope: Latent invariance API risk, not evidence current CLI artifacts are wrong.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate nonempty ordered-unique universe and require observed truth ⊆ labels; allow registered absent classes.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Reuse MetricContract/frozen class universe across evaluation APIs.
findings.regression_test: Missing observed class and duplicate labels reject; registered absent class remains and scores zero.

findings.title: Character-offset segmentation is published under token metric names
findings.evidence: Schema accepts offset_unit=character and verifier uses len(text), but scorer passes ranges to token-named SegmentationDocument/TokenMetrics and emits n_tokens/token_accuracy/token_macro_f1 without offset unit.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Score a valid character-offset mixed document; numerical character-position metrics are serialized as token metrics.
findings.actual_consequence: Metric estimand/unit is mislabeled in public benchmark results.
findings.affected_scope: Mixed-authorship benchmark character-offset mode.
findings.minimal_fix: Forbid character offsets in v1 scientific scoring or make every result field/unit explicit.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Unit-parameterized segmentation contract and ScoreEnvelope binding offset_unit.
findings.regression_test: Character mode either rejects or emits character_* names/unit; token fixtures remain unchanged.

findings.title: Benchmark endpoints are truth-field-driven rather than task-registration-driven
findings.evidence: Manifest validation only checks document tasks are a subset of top-level tasks. Truth validation requires spans for mixed_authorship but does not forbid them otherwise or enforce exact task→truth field membership/nonzero endpoint counts. Work is optional; all-missing work silently selects document rather than work bootstrap.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: A spoof-only document with truth/predicted spans emits segmentation metrics; a declared top-level task can have zero observations and silently produce no metric. Omit work on all documents and bootstrap auto falls back to document groups.
findings.actual_consequence: Later truth can add/omit metric families and denominators outside registration; missing work can pseudoreplicate multiple documents/editions and change the registered uncertainty unit.
findings.affected_scope: Public benchmark endpoint/control-plane contract.
findings.minimal_fix: Define and enforce task→allowed/required truth fields and nonzero registered endpoint coverage.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Versioned endpoint matrix in manifest/escrow and ScoreEnvelope with exact denominators.
findings.regression_test: Spoof-only spans reject; unused declared task rejects; valid multi-task docs score only registered endpoints.

findings.title: Configuration invariants use asserts that disappear under python -O
findings.evidence: User/config invariants are assert statements.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Run Python with -O; asserts are removed.
findings.actual_consequence: Invalid configuration may proceed to later opaque failure.
findings.affected_scope: Feature/Delta configuration.
findings.minimal_fix: Replace with typed ValueError/domain exception.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Central constructor validation.
findings.regression_test: Optimized interpreter rejects same invalid configs.

findings.title: StyloVectorizer consumes generators twice
findings.evidence: Representation preprocessing consumes iterable, then original exhausted iterator is passed to blocks.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Pass a generator rather than list; downstream blocks see no texts.
findings.actual_consequence: Public-ish API behaves differently by iterable type.
findings.affected_scope: Vectorizer input normalization.
findings.minimal_fix: Materialize once and reuse.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Explicit Sequence contract or normalized immutable batch.
findings.regression_test: List and generator produce identical matrices.

findings.title: Headline gate does not explicitly reject nonfinite CI bounds
findings.evidence: NaN comparison becomes inconclusive rather than a typed malformed-result failure; internal computed CIs are otherwise validated/frequently finite.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Pass NaN bound into gate object.
findings.actual_consequence: Malformed external input can be mislabeled inconclusive rather than corrupt.
findings.affected_scope: Headline helper boundary, not evidence of current headline corruption.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate finite ordered bounds.
findings.preferred_architectural_fix: Reuse statistical interval contract.
findings.regression_test: NaN/inf/reversed bounds reject.

findings.title: Dormant LR factory would use non-grouped chunk calibration if reactivated
findings.evidence: make_classifier builds CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=3) without groups. No callers were found in current src/scripts/tests; active full pipeline does not use it.
findings.reproduction_or_static_trace: Static reachability scan; if called on chunks from works, ordinary CV can mix a work across calibration folds.
